Option B (your treasury prefers single settlement):

Couple of asks from our side:
- Can you share ACH details for AP (account, routing, bank name) or confirm wire beneficiary?

I attached: payment_instructions_kim_2027-07.pdf (wire + ACH instructions) and a short mutual_action_plan_avelon.xlsx outlining dates and owners.
